properties.name: Yamunotri
properties.description: Yamunotri, is the source of the Yamuna River and the seat of the Goddess Yamuna in Hinduism.

properties.name: Gangotri
properties.description: It is a Hindu pilgrim town on the banks of the river Bhagirathi - the origin of the river Ganges.

properties.name: Badrinath
properties.description: The Badrinath Temple also known as the Badrinarayan Temple, located in Uttarakhand's Badrinath town, is one of the four important pilgrimages in the state.

properties.name: Kedarnath
properties.description: Kedarnath is a prominent pilgrimage center and is part of twelve auspicious and holy jyothirlingas (a manifestation of Lord Shiva).
